Touch: left stick down = descend, up = climb; sideways = yaw. Right stick = pitch / roll. Release to level and hold altitude. Counter-steer to brake.

Ocean: choose OFFSHORE in CHOOSE AREA + AIRCRAFT, apply, then ARM. ALT is height above ground or mean sea level. HOME points to the airfield. Water contact ends the flight. Course finish unlocks free flight. Areas are connected across the island; relocation is optional. Simulated flight and video. No hardware connection.
